old_value: {"id":"JMAP-9imn","title":"scene-vtc: suppress SceneAvatarEvent for E2EE-bound regions","description":"draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00 L2413 (jmap-chat-spec 0cd3af0): when a SceneRegion's activeCallId references a VTCCall with e2eeEnabled true, the server SHOULD suppress SceneAvatarEvent delivery for that region to subscribers who are not participants in the bound VTCCall; servers that cannot MUST document the limitation. jmap-scene-server::should_deliver (JMAP-z996.3) does not do this because the VTC lookup belongs in the crate-jmap-scene-vtc-server binding crate (Mark 2026-10-20, JMAP-z996.4 notes).","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-20T16:22:22.829930766Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-20T16:22:22.829930766Z"}

{"notes":"Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Hide SceneAvatar records of E2EE-call regions in get/query
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L2606: "the server SHOULD NOT expose the region's SceneAvatar records to users who are not participants in the bound VTCCall: for such users it SHOULD return `notFound` for `SceneAvatar/get`, exclude the records from `SceneAvatar/query`, and suppress `SceneAvatarEvent` delivery"; wss-00 L1233: "That suppression applies to `SceneAvatarEvent` delivered through `SceneStreamEnable` and through `ChatStreamEnable` alike".
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:54-60; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/ephemeral.rs:176-235; crate-jmap-scene-vtc-server/src/lib.rs:1-12
Now: No E2EE handling anywhere in the scene crates. SceneAvatar/get and /query and should_deliver never consult the bound VTCCall's e2eeEnabled.
Change: Add a hook (for example, a SceneBackend may_see_avatars or an is_object_visible extension) that scene-vtc-server implements from VTCCall.e2eeEnabled and participants. Apply it in SceneAvatar/get (notFound), SceneAvatar/query (exclude) and should_deliver for SceneAvatarEvent. JMAP-9imn covers the event part only; widen it to get/query."}
